task_title: Finalize the English canonical/locale/edition blueprint and prove the whole-English importer
result: PASS — canonical identities are translation-neutral, canon-scoped definitions are consolidated to one payload per key, reconciliation references the global registry with creation provenance moved to the registry, canon validation covers every English record class, and the idempotent whole-English importer proves one entity row per canonical entity with separate attestations/localization/mentions and correct replay semantics.
user_visible_outcome: The English structure is a stable blueprint: a future language or translation can be added as new locale/edition packages over the same translation-neutral canonical packages and the same global registry. The whole-English draft imports into the private staging database with one row per canonical entity (Jerusalem included) and separate tables for book attestations, English descriptions and BSB mentions.

scope.in_scope: English (BSB) canonical/locale/edition structure, global registry, canon validation, whole-English importer and its database test.
scope.out_of_scope: content/curated/tel/** (treated as non-authoritative and untouched), content publication, and the mobile UI (unchanged).

structure.translation_neutral_canonical: canonical package identities are draft:wb-<book>-canonical with null language_tag and translation_edition_key; no BSB string. Edition packages are draft:wb-bsb-<book>-edition and carry the immutable edition key edition:bsb@20260912:sha-b2898c49 (identical to the database row). Locale packages are draft:wb-en-<book>-locale with language_tag en and no edition.
structure.consolidated_definitions: entity candidates, place definitions and entity profiles are emitted exactly once, in the entity's home book (Nehemiah for locked Neh2 identities). Other books carry registry-backed reconciliation references only. Cross-book multi-payload count is now 0 for every record class.
structure.reconciliation: reconciliation records reference the existing global registry (canonical_entity_key, resolution_status resolved_existing); candidate_key is optional and retained only for the locked Neh2 candidate-resolution records.
structure.registry_provenance: creation provenance moved to content/curated/registry/entities.json: every entry carries provenance, created_from (home canonical package) and source, plus a registry-level provenance_policy.
structure.contract: packages/content-schema pkgReconciliationSchema.candidate_key is now optional and validateCanonicalPackage resolves entities from a registry-backed reconciliation set; backward compatible (Neh2 and all existing tests pass).

validation.tools/validate_canon.py: PASS — extended to every English record class (candidates, claims, citations, attestations, relationships, events, places, relevance, mentions, profiles, contexts, localizations) with key-grammar checks, identity-neutrality checks, registry-reference checks, coverage-partition checks and the identity/locked-Neh2 check.

counts.note: Current as of the code/model remediation (findings 16-44): entities 4312, attestations 36426, mentions 33338 (all mention occurrences captured, finding 41; +2609 over first-occurrence-only). Events dropped from 2336 to the 6 curated locked Nehemiah 2 events (heading-derived events removed); relationships 5024 after the controlled predicate ontology dropped king/lady/raper/concubinator. Publication-safety round: the bundle now gates names/mentions/relevance/relationships/events by their own origin publication + review_state (blocker 1); English ownership cleanup targets every en.bsb.all@* manifest so a revision change cannot orphan old rows (blocker 2); the importer's entity/claim upserts skip rows that are members of a published package (blocker 3). supabase/tests/12 proves cross-revision cleanup and published-row immutability. Safe-fix round: one active release per locale (unique partial index); published_verses gated on an active published package (approval/rights/release), not edition status alone; YHVH_1 no longer maps to two entities and a unique (source, external_id) index enforces it; place comments citing commercial/reference works are rejected; reader-facing place names strip disambiguation suffixes via display_name (searchable names stay unique) and the Forunatus typo is corrected to Fortunatus. Publication-safety blockers: importer resync deletes package_members before context_revisions (FK order) and only touches UNPUBLISHED English manifests, preserving published history; published-record guards are no longer bypassed (unpublished memberships only are cleaned); a new migration 21 recreates the published API/functions with direct attestation ownership and no NULL-origin publishability; migration 20 reconciles duplicate external IDs before the unique index. import-neh2 now creates a draft manifest and sets origin_package_id so the locked slice stays publishable. Remaining blockers: many-to-many publishable membership (private_staging.package_row_memberships + row_is_published) so unchanged rows survive a release transition; context revisions are versioned per import (no reuse of revision 1); event scope accounts require their own published membership (R2); supabase/tests/13_release_transition_test.sql executes an import N -> publish -> N+1 -> activate transition. A 'post-it author signature' UI request is logged as a deferred product request in docs/PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md. Upgrade-safety round: migration 22 backfills package_row_memberships from origin_package_id for every supported row type (existing DBs keep published content after the membership switch), and IMPORT_REVISION/MANIFEST_REVISION bumped 6->7 so an existing installation re-runs the upgraded importer. English membership is now populated from the EXACT natural keys in the curated files (VALUES CTEs), not broad entity/scope queries, so it can never claim another package's rows. supabase/tests/14_membership_backfill_test.sql covers the upgraded-database backfill; tests 13 verifies the release transition. Corrective round: fixed the malformed membership VALUES (no extra outer parens; single-column sets normalised to 1-tuples), added scope_id and language_tag='en' to the exact membership lookups, moved the backfill to additive migration 23 (migration 22 left as committed), and rewrote test 14 to execute migration 23 and assert memberships for all 11 row types. crs fix: the importer writes crs='unknown' for positions without coordinates (place_geometries.crs is NOT NULL), and test 14 uses a non-null crs; the duplicated backfill was removed from migration 22 (kept only in additive migration 23).

importer.proof: entities 4312 registry rows; entity:jerusalem exactly 1 row; 36426 attestations, 4301 English descriptions and 33338 BSB mentions in separate tables; 31086 BSB verses across 1189 chapters and 66 works.
importer.replay: identical replay prints 'no-op' and changes no counts; conflicting replay exits 3 before any write; the same guard is emitted inside the transaction for --emit-sql (finding 33).
importer.transactional: all writes run in one psql -1 transaction; the conflicting-replay check runs before any statement.

validation.database_test: supabase/tests/11_english_canon_import_test.sql — one entity row per key, Jerusalem singleton, structural separation, attestation/mention resolution, whole-canon coverage, draft-only, anon denied. supabase/tests/12_upgrade_convergence_test.sql — ownership-scoped resync deletes owned rows, keeps NULL-origin rows, no orphan memberships, natural uniqueness. Gate: tools/verify-english-canon.sh (npm run verify:english-canon), now included in verify:all (finding 36).
validation.contract_tests: packages/content-schema: 8 suites, 187 tests passed (wholeBibleGenerated now validates against independent authority: skeleton, registry, ontology).
validation.repo: root typecheck exit 0; content-schema lint exit 0; prettier back to the 3 known pre-existing warnings; verify:preview up to date; import-neh2 --check passes.

database_changes.migrations: none — the importer reuses private_staging (canons, scripture_works, reference_systems/units, scripture_scopes, translation_works/editions/verses, entities, entity_names, entity_descriptions, claims, claim_citations, reference_entity_attestations, edition_mentions, scope_entity_relevance, entity_relationship_assertions, events/participants/places/accounts, place_geometries, context_artifacts/revisions/sections, curation_imports).
database_changes.permissions: unchanged — private_staging stays RLS-enabled with revoked anon/authenticated grants; the test asserts anon sees zero rows.

known_limitations: Objects, roles, practices, terms, themes, chronology and meaningful historical context remain uncurated and are marked not_attempted; no filler was added.

The whole-English importer imports the current draft classes; claims/citations/events/relationships are populated from the locked Nehemiah 2 content and the structural projections, not from new curation.
supabase/tests/08 (Neh2) asserts exact Neh2-only counts and assumes a database where only the Neh2 import ran; the English canon gate is separate (tools/verify-english-canon.sh).
Nothing is reviewed, approved or published; content/curated/tel/** is untouched and non-authoritative.
stop_condition: Stopped after the English structure and the idempotent importer passed full-canon validation (tools/validate_canon.py PASS, contract tests 254/254, tools/verify-english-canon.sh ENGLISH-CANON-TESTS-PASS). Telugu was not curated, no content was published, and the mobile UI was not changed.
